title: Workshop: Build a self-hosted cloud agent.
summary: Build a self-hosted cloud agent with the LiteLLM team. A two-week remote workshop, October 19–30, to build a working v0 and deploy an internal beta on your infrastructure.
body_markdown:
PROGRAM DETAILS


## Timeline & milestones​


From your first use case to an internal beta in two weeks. Here’s what we build together at each stage.


1. 01


BEFORE WE BUILD


30 MINUTES


### Scope your first use case.​


We review your goals, what you’ve tried, and your providers, sandbox, and cloud setup. Together, we agree on scope, deployment timing, and success criteria.


YOU LEAVE WITH


A build plan for your first use case.


Your build brief


Intake


**Use case** The first workflow to build


**Stack** Providers, sandbox, and cloud


**Success criteria** What a useful v0 needs to do


2. 02


WEEK 1 · BUILD


OCTOBER 19–23


### Get a working cloud agent.​


We connect your agent harness and sandbox to a web app and Slack. Your team can send it tasks and try the first workflow.


WEEK-ONE TARGET


A working v0 you can interact with.


Your working v0


Web app


Slack


Sandbox


Agent harness


Powered by


3. 03


WEEK 2 · DEPLOY


OCTOBER 26–30


### Run an internal beta.​


We deploy to your cloud, run internal tasks, and review traces with your team. We improve the agent based on what you see.


Depending on scope: shared memory, additional harnesses such as Pi, and feedback and trace review tools.


WEEK-TWO TARGET


An internal beta on your infrastructure.


Internal beta


Your cloud


**Deploy**


**Run tasks**


**Improve**


**Review traces**


Test with your team’s real workflows.


4. 04


AFTER THE WORKSHOP


FOR LITELLM USERS


### Keep improving with our team.​


If you use LiteLLM, we continue working with you toward the success criteria from your intake call.


CONTINUED SUPPORT


Help with your next improvements.


Keep building together
